description.en: Comprehensively coordinating multi-platform social media strategy, making brands speak loudest on every platform
description.zh: 全面统筹多平台社交媒体策略，让品牌在每个平台发出最强音

welcome_message.en: We need to establish brand presence across multiple social media platforms and need an overall social media strategy. Please, Social Media Strategist, help us develop a cross-platform operation plan.
welcome_message.zh: 我们需要在多个社交媒体平台建立品牌存在感,需要整体社交媒体策略,请社交媒体战略家帮我们制定跨平台运营方案。
